purpose: Teach: 盧/洲/卿/大王/艦長/豪州/ムスリム/キリスト教徒

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、韓国の盧元大統領の関係事案を、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: So with this case involving the former Korean president—the police are handling it with care, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful tone. Slight pause before the dash as if consulting notes. Gentle lift at the end—genuinely curious about confirmation, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧満洲、つまり満洲国洲の遺品鑑定もされますね
lines.en: And the police are also conducting appraisals of artifacts from old Manchuria—the Manchukuo era—aren't they?
lines.style: Professional, affirming. Matches Ren's pace and register. Steady voice, like ticking items off a list. The parenthetical comes as a clarification, spoken with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、英国卿位の人物関連の捜査を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: So regarding this case with the British peer involved—the police are investigating that carefully too, yes?
lines.style: Same reflective cadence as before. Slightly deeper breath before the question. Searching tone, as if wanting confirmation that they're on the same page about the scope.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、大王、つまり古代大王陵の盗掘事件も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police are also handling the looting cases at ancient royal tombs—the great burial mounds—as well?
lines.style: Even tone, slightly more official. The clarification lands as routine administrative detail. No rush. A small acknowledgment nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、自衛艦の艦長への取材調整を、警察、ご手配されますね
lines.en: With this case too—the interview arrangements with the naval destroyer captain—the police are coordinating that, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before naming the captain's role. Slightly formal register. The turn at the end is searching but not challenging—genuinely checking alignment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、豪州、つまりオーストラリア当局と国際捜査連携されますね
lines.en: And the police are also coordinating international investigation efforts with Australian authorities, I understand?
lines.style: Calm, procedural. The parenthetical clarification comes as expected knowledge. Voice is steady, almost confirming something already discussed. Professional distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ムスリム住民へのヘイト事件を、警察、毅然と対応されますね
lines.en: And with this case—the hate incidents against Muslim residents—the police are responding firmly, aren't they?
lines.style: Quieter than before. Weight on 'firmly.' A slight lean forward in the voice, like this matters differently. Not accusatory, but more direct than the earlier questions.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、キリスト教徒の集会への警備も担当されますね
lines.en: The police are also providing security for Christian community gatherings, I presume?
lines.style: Steady, practical tone. More concise than previous lines. A knowing nod in the voice—less a question, more a confirmation of understood duty. Professional closure.
